author: Puzzle guy
title: Remove the ring from the puzzle #shorts
review_method: Downloaded public video; reviewed frames spanning the full clip and enlarged initial, side, and threading views.

observations.description: Wooden base and upright with a single elongated slot. Closed target ring surrounds the post foot. One white cord passes through the slot and has two beads and two round terminal discs.
Lifting the ring over the post leaves it caught on the cord. The beads fit the ring; the larger discs prevent direct removal.
The ring returns to the post; cord loops are rearranged and the terminal discs are turned edgewise at the long slot.
The ring lifts over the post with the rearranged cord and clears the bead/loop, ending separate from the puzzle.

initial_topology.return_tail: around the right side of the post, outside the right rail
initial_topology.ring: closed, initially horizontal around the foot of the post
initial_topology.terminals: one bored bead and one larger disc at each end

uncertainties: Absolute dimensions, cord material, mass and friction cannot be measured from this clip.
Bead sliding freedom and hidden terminal knot construction are not established; constraints must be resolved before dynamics.
The reconstructed tail poses are authored for inspection, not the result of gravity settling.
Observed human actions are not a validated robot solution.
